g.title: ARDS_QSP
g.text: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Diffuse alveolar damage: epithelial + endothelial barrier failure → protein-rich alveolar oedema → shunt, dead space, loss of aerated 'baby lung'
Ventilator-induced lung injury (volu-/baro-/atelec-/bio-trauma) as an iatrogenic amplifier · fibroproliferative vs resolution fork · hyper- vs hypo-inflammatory subphenotypes
Pharmacology & interventions: corticosteroids · neuromuscular blockade · prone position · conservative fluids · inhaled pulmonary vasodilators · VV-ECMO · IL-6R blockade / JAK inhibition (COVID-ARDS)
